adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, the code directly accesses `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` without checking that `params[:embeddable_host]` is present (new file `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`). If a client sends a malformed request (or wrong content-type/body) that omits the `embeddable_host` wrapper key, this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil[:host]`, resulting in a 500 instead of a handled 4xx error.
